<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate" name="Company status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter (friends)"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offer" messageRef="Message_Offer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyUpdate1" name="Status update 1" messageRef="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_CompanyUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyUpdate2" name="Status update 2" messageRef="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_CompanyUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyUpdate3" name="Status update 3" messageRef="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_CompanyUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet" messageRef="Message_Tweet" sourceRef="Task_RecommendCompany" targetRef="Participant_Twitter"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Internship (Student)" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Internship search started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Topic</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterTopicSalary" name="Enter topic and desired salary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Topic</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Topic_Experience</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Topic_Experience</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Experience_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferMerge" name="Waiting for offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Experience_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deny_Loop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Offer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferReceived" name="Offer received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Offer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Offer_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OfferReceived" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewOffer" name="Review offer and accept or deny">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Offer_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Offer accepted?" default="Flow_Deny_Loop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deny_Loop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Topic" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicSalary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Topic_Experience" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicSalary" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Experience_Merge" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Offer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer_Review" sourceRef="Event_OfferReceived" targetRef="Task_ReviewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReviewOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_Internship_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerAccepted == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny_Loop" name="Denied" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_InvalidOffers">
      <bpmn:text>Accepting an offer makes all other offers invalid</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_Annotation" sourceRef="TextAnnotation_InvalidOffers" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Internship_Split" name="Internship running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Student</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Company</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Student" sourceRef="Gateway_Internship_Split" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Company" sourceRef="Gateway_Internship_Split" targetRef="Event_CompanyUpdate1"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StatusUpdate1" name="Write status update 1">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Student</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SU1_Timer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_Week1" name="One week later">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SU1_Timer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Timer1_SU2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_Week1">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StatusUpdate2" name="Write status update 2">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Timer1_SU2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SU2_Timer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_Week2" name="One week later">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SU2_Timer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Timer2_SU3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_Week2">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StatusUpdate3" name="Write status update 3">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Timer2_SU3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SU3_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SU1_Timer" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate1" targetRef="Timer_Week1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timer1_SU2" sourceRef="Timer_Week1" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SU2_Timer" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate2" targetRef="Timer_Week2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timer2_SU3" sourceRef="Timer_Week2" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SU3_Join" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate3" targetRef="Gateway_Internship_Join"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyUpdate1" name="Company status update 1">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Company</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CU1_CU2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CU1" messageRef="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyUpdate2" name="Company status update 2">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CU1_CU2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CU2_CU3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CU2" messageRef="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyUpdate3" name="Company status update 3">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CU2_CU3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CU3_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CU3" messageRef="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CU1_CU2" sourceRef="Event_CompanyUpdate1" targetRef="Event_CompanyUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CU2_CU3" sourceRef="Event_CompanyUpdate2" targetRef="Event_CompanyUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CU3_Join" sourceRef="Event_CompanyUpdate3" targetRef="Gateway_Internship_Join"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Internship_Join" name="Internship finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SU3_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CU3_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Recommend</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_Internship_Join" targetRef="Task_RecommendCompany"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RecommendCompany" name="Recommend company to friends via Twitter" messageRef="Message_Tweet">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Recommend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Recommend_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Recommend_End" sourceRef="Task_RecommendCompany" targetRef="EndEvent_Done"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Done" name="Recommendations sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Recommend_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
